name: Michael Juba
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Michael Juba, the managing partner and owner of The Juba Law Office, PLLC, in Denver, Colorado, provides personalized legal representation across a diverse spectrum of cases. His proficiency spans municipal, state and federal criminal matters, juvenile delinquency proceedings, civil protection order hearings, traffic offenses, pre-file representation in criminal investigations, state regulatory hearings, civil litigation, post-conviction petitions and appeals.

Additionally, Mr. Juba is a licensed real estate agent and landlord, dedicating part of his practice to real estate law, offering counsel on contracts, leases and eviction matters, and representing tenants and landlords in disputes. Moreover, recognized for his sound judgment and advice, he is a trusted resource for attorneys and clients, mainly when dealing with high-stakes situations.

With extensive trial and litigation experience throughout Colorado's various courts, Mr. Juba has successfully handled numerous trials and contested hearings, ranging from minor traffic infractions to serious homicide offenses. He holds licenses to practice in all Colorado state and municipal courts, the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 10th Circuit.

Mr. Juba earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Colorado Boulder in 2003, followed by a Juris Doctor from the University of Colorado School of Law in 2007. He was admitted to practice law in Colorado the same year. He commenced his professional journey at the Denver Trial Office of the Colorado State Public Defender, diligently advocating for numerous indigent clients across the county, juvenile and district court settings.

An expert on the constitutional rights of children, Mr. Juba concentrates on the legal representation of young individuals facing serious charges in adult court. He has authored works on applying the 8th Amendment to children. He has also garnered recognition from peers and earned a consistent placement in 5280 Magazine's Top Juvenile Defense Lawyers in Colorado for the past four years.

Mr. Juba is a sought-after speaker at legal conferences and law schools, imparting knowledge on children's constitutional rights. Furthermore, he co-founded the nonprofit organization Learn Your Rights in the Community, which trains children on asserting their constitutional rights during interactions with law enforcement.

Beyond his legal practice, Mr. Juba dedicates his time to making valuable contributions to the community. He generously volunteers by coaching youth sports teams and holding positions on the boards of various organizations, legal committees, and nonprofits.
